Its dimensions are38,102,201,321 for d2,3,4,5 and128d-320 for d>=6. The existing d2 certificate and three exact original-source determinants close the finite remainder of the uniform bulk theorem. Other odd characteristics, dimensions above8 and pre-stable thresholds are not asserted.
